notes: Full diff on feat/portfolio-value-chart reviewed against the approved design.md and the 23 acceptance criteria; every automatable criterion is satisfied with no HIGH/MEDIUM finding. RPC (migrations/20250109000001) matches design §1 exactly: SECURITY DEFINER + set search_path=public, no args, returns int; not_authenticated/no_account bare-code guards; v_last = today ET - 1 (never writes today, AC-7); coalesce(total_cents,0) on both cash legs (nullable-column guard); carry-forward correlated close lookup with missing-bar=0; defensive greatest(...,0) cash clamp reconstructed from the ledger not live cash; idempotent on-conflict upsert on (account_id, snap_date); grants revoke public/anon and grant authenticated; DIVERGENCE/clamp/null-coalesce comments all present. pgTAP commits plan(22) with all 22 assertions (AC-1..AC-11). src/types/db.ts adds Functions.backfill_portfolio_snapshots { Args: Record<PropertyKey,never>; Returns: number } (AC-12). Client slice matches design §4-§9: use-portfolio-history (RANGE_DAYS, pure rangeCutoffDate with ALL=null, ['portfolio-history',range] key, ascending snap_date select, no user id, AC-13/14); use-backfill-portfolio-history (no-arg RPC, zod result schema, mapBackfillError, invalidates ['portfolio-history'] + PORTFOLIO_QUERY_KEY, AC-15); pure chart-geometry (null empty domain, flat +/-1 fallback, padding clamp, single-point centring, AC-16); PortfolioValueChart (props-only, no supabase import, Polyline >1 / Circle ==1 / 'No chart data yet' empty / loading placeholder, gain/loss tint + signed a11y label, Paper money tag, AC-16/17); portfolio range-toggle exposes 1M/3M/1Y/5Y/ALL with selected state and onPrimary/textMuted colors (AC-18); barrel exports the component + PORTFOLIO_CHART_RANGES and intentionally omits ChartRange (design N3); portfolio.tsx wires the chart card above PortfolioSummary with default range '3M', sparse(<=1)-card, once-per-mount firedRef backfill latch, and pending/error captions, leaving all existing content and the Gate intact (FR-6). NFR/AC-22 held: package.json and package-lock.json unchanged, no charting-library import, app/(tabs)/portfolio.tsx is the only app/ change. Independently re-verified in the worktree: `npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `npx expo lint` clean (exit 0), and the portfolio Jest suites pass (42/42 across the 4 new test files plus the updated portfolio-screen test). Device/simulator-only criteria AC-18 (live range refetch+redraw), AC-19 (curve at 3M with existing content intact), AC-20 (sparse card -> once-per-mount backfill -> curve), AC-21 (brand-new account keeps empty state) are out-of-scope-for-automation and verified by inspection of the wiring, not treated as defects. The only non-green automatable check is the live pgTAP run, blocked solely by the local Docker/DB being down (documented, not a code defect).
